# Rock Solid Tile

> Family-owned, licensed & insured tile installation contractor serving Southwest
> Florida (Charlotte, Sarasota, Manatee, and Lee Counties) for over 30 years.
> 1,000+ completed jobs, 5-star rated. Free estimates on every project.

Phone: (941) 276-0305
Email: info@rsitile.com
Service area: Southwest Florida — Sarasota, Venice, North Port, Port Charlotte,
Punta Gorda, Cape Coral, Bradenton, and surrounding communities.

## Services

- [Bathroom Tile Installation](https://rsitile.com/services/bathroom-tile-installation.html): Bathroom floor tile, tub surrounds, and full bathroom remodels. Typical project cost: $7,000–$15,000.
- [Shower Tile Installation](https://rsitile.com/services/shower-tile-installation.html): Custom tile showers with niches, benches, curbless entries, and waterproofing. Typical project cost: $4,000–$10,000.
- [Kitchen Tile & Backsplash Installation](https://rsitile.com/services/kitchen-tile-installation.html): Kitchen floor tile and custom backsplashes. Typical backsplash cost: $2,000–$5,000.
- [Floor Tile Installation](https://rsitile.com/services/floor-tile-installation.html): Ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and LVP flooring. Typical whole-house floor tile cost: $10,000–$20,000.
- [Patio & Lanai Tile Installation](https://rsitile.com/services/patio-lanai-tile.html): Slip-resistant outdoor tile for lanais, patios, and pool decks.

Larger whole-home tile projects combining floors, kitchen, and bathrooms typically
run $20,000–$50,000 depending on scope.
